integrations_github_account_description: Authorize your GitHub account for all your Agents.
integrations_github_error_authentication: Sign in to openTag, then authorize your GitHub account.
integrations_github_error_conflict: Your GitHub authorization has changed. Refresh the page and try again.
integrations_github_error_flow_expired: This GitHub authorization attempt expired. Try again.
integrations_github_error_flow_invalid: The GitHub authorization could not be completed. Try again.
integrations_github_error_generic: The GitHub request could not be completed.
integrations_github_error_identity_misma: This authorization used a different GitHub account. Choose Change account to use that account.
integrations_github_error_rate_limited: GitHub's request limit has been reached. Try again shortly.
integrations_github_error_state: This action isn't available right now. Refresh the page and try again.
integrations_github_error_token_lifetime: The GitHub OAuth App's authorization settings need to be updated. Contact your openTag administrator.
integrations_github_error_upstream: GitHub is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
integrations_github_reauthorize_descript: Authorize this account again so your Agents can continue using GitHub.
integrations_github_remove_description: All your Agents will lose GitHub access through {account}. Ongoing code tasks may be affected.
integrations_github_remove_scope: Disconnecting in openTag does not revoke your authorization on GitHub. You can revoke it in GitHub settings.
integrations_github_repositories_descrip: Your Agents can access these repositories.
integrations_github_repositories_empty: No accessible repositories found. Check your GitHub account permissions and OAuth authorization.
integrations_github_repositories_help: This list includes repositories available through your GitHub account's OAuth authorization. All your Agents share this scope.
integrations_github_repositories_incompl: The repository list is incomplete. You can check repository access on GitHub.
integrations_github_repositories_no_matc: No matching repositories in this list.
integrations_github_repositories_operati: Reading code, pushing changes, and creating pull requests remain subject to GitHub permissions and repository rules.
integrations_github_repositories_organiz: If organization repositories are missing, check the organization's OAuth access policy or contact an administrator.
integrations_github_repositories_partial: Some repositories couldn't be loaded. Try again.
No matches in the loaded repositories.
integrations_github_repositories_refresh: Couldn't refresh repositories. The previous results are still shown. Try again.
integrations_github_repository_help: OAuth repository access follows your GitHub account permissions. All your Agents share this account authorization and repository access.
integrations_github_repository_help_orga: Organization repositories may require organization approval or SSO authorization.
integrations_github_unavailable_descript: The GitHub OAuth App hasn't been set up for openTag. Contact your openTag administrator.
